correctness.rationale: Any two vertices in the same independent part have distance two and a shortest path via any outside vertex. Thus X dual iff Y=V\X meets outside each part i having x_i≥2 or y_i≥2. Inclusion–exclusion for bad Y⊂V_i yields D_i=z^N+z^{N−2} when n_i=2, D_i=z^(N−n_i)(1+z)^n_i when n_i≥3; bad families intersect only for Y=∅, so correction (p−1)z^N. Two-color constructions and star-center obstruction yield exact χ. Independent direct subset enumeration checks representative multipartite profiles and all coefficients, finite check only corroborative.
residual_risks: Independent exact checks are auxiliary; analytic argument carries quantified theorem.
